question: Two-point measure: keep the caliper H/V-only or offer the mock free-angle version?
context: The redline mock renders the live two-point measurement as a caliper rotated to any angle. The shipped caliper is deliberately horizontal/vertical only after the 16.12 redesign. Spec: docs/design/next-measure.md section 3, last paragraph.

options.label: Keep H/V only
options.detail: The 16.12 redesign deliberately dropped free/diagonal mode for one opinionated interaction. UX redlining is almost always axis-aligned; the mock hint (click two points) still works, the caliper just levels to the dominant axis.

options.label: H/V default, modifier for free angle
options.detail: Hold Shift while placing the second point to get a rotated caliper measuring the true diagonal; release-to-level otherwise.

options.label: Free angle by default (as the mock draws)
options.detail: The live caliper rotates to the exact angle between the two clicked points; brings back the complexity 16.12 removed.
